{"metadata":{"description":"为 DSH Web UI 增加跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入能力，无需复制文件","id":"gh:1324718909","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-drag-and-drop","slug":"bill9109/dsh-drag-and-drop","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"为 DSH Web UI 增加跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入能力，无需复制文件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-drag-and-drop — Drag local files in and insert their real paths"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Install:** `dsh plugin --profile web add github:omdsh-dev/dsh-drag-and-drop`"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin: drag local files or folders onto any part of the page and their "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"original absolute filesystem paths are inserted into the current conversation input — without upload"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ing, moving, or copying anything.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A browser never hands a web page the real filesystem path of a dropped file — it exposes only a loca"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"l file URI when it feels like it, and often nothing at all, for security. DSH, though, operates on r"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"eal files: its tools read, run, and patch actual paths on the machine. Drop a file into an ordinary "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"web input and you get either an upload (a copy that silently breaks the file's relationship with its"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" neighboring dependencies) or a hand-typed path that is easy to get wrong."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin closes that gap on the machine running DSH. It converts the browser's local file URI int"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"o the native absolute path, and when the browser hides the path entirely it resolves the file back t"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"o its real location — through the current Workspace, registered Workspaces, the OS file index, and a"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" bounded directory search — then writes that path into the current conversation input. - Full-page dim + b"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"lur hint while dragging
- Supports files and folders; drag multiple items at once — one path per lin"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"e
- Native paths on macOS, Linux, and Windows
- POSIX paths, Windows drive-letter paths, and UNC net"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"work paths
- No uploading, moving, or copying of files
- Locates files in the current Workspace and "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"registered Workspaces first
- When the browser hides the original path, uses the local file index an"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"d bounded directory search
- Computes content fingerprints only when multiple candidates exist
- Whe"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"n several byte-identical copies cannot be told apart automatically, lets the user pick the path

| Wrong path inserted when several copies share a "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"name | Candidates are filtered by full file name and size, then content-sampled only among the survi"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"vors. If byte-identical copies remain, the plugin shows a chooser — pick the correct path there |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Privacy & file access"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The plugin never:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- uploads files

- moves files
- modifies files
- deletes files"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"In most cases the plugin only reads file metadata."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Only when multiple candidates share the same name and size does it read a small amount of content to"},{"id":"p38s2","text":" compute sampled fingerprints, and only when large files cannot be told apart by sampling does it re"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"ad the full content to compute SHA-256."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"All resolution and fingerprinting happens locally on the machine running DSH."}],"truncated":true}
